title: mri_concatenate_lta
description: Concatenates two consecutive LTA transformations into one overall transformation, Out = LTA2*LTA1

lta_1.description: File for LTA transformation that maps some src1 to dst1
lta_1.title: LTA 1 File

lta_2.description: File for LTA transformation that maps dst1 (src2) to dst2
lta_2.title: LTA 2 File

lta_final.description: File for the combined LTA maps: src1 to dst2 = LTA2*LTA1
lta_final.title: LTA Final File

out_type.description: Set final LTA type: 0 for VOX2VOX (default), 1 for RAS2RAS
out_type.title: Output Type

rmsdiff_radius.description: Radius used for computing RMS diff between transforms
rmsdiff_radius.title: RMS Diff Radius

rmsdiff_outputfile.description: Output file for RMS diff computation. Use 'nofile' to skip output
rmsdiff_outputfile.title: RMS Diff Output File
